Review rules (sokdam_review.tsv): entries whose hits are mostly Wikipedia and look like film/drama/book titles are scored on the other two corpora only; entries that only matched a generic partial phrase are scored on full matches only (dropped from the top 100 when there is none); variants of one proverb count once.

#   score, kowiki / kowikisource / opensubtitles = raw hit counts, note.
# sokdam100 = top 100 of all dictionaries (krdict, stdict, opendict); sokdam_all = krdict's proverbs, counted ones first, then zero-count ones in 가나다 order.
